description: Offline scan of a book's own text for a checksum-valid ISBN → sets identifiers:isbn (no network; for online lookup use calibre_recover_metadata). Preview-first: apply=false reports only, merges into existing identifiers. Previews work without writes; applying needs CALIBRE_MCP_ENABLE_WRITE.
name: calibre_extract_isbn

writeEnabled.description: false on a preview in a session with writes disabled: applying it will be refused (write_disabled)

title: Extract ISBN from book text
